description: Removal of single storey modular building; erection of a single-storey office and welfare building and a single-storey storage building, provision of on-site car parking, and associated works.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans: 3606/PWS/01 Rev. A, 3606/PWS/02 Rev. B, 3606/PWS/03 Rev. B, 3606/PWS/04 Rev. D, 3606/PWS/05 Rev. B, 3606/PWS/06 Rev. D, 3606/PWS/07 Rev. E, 3606/PWS/08 Rev. E, 3606/PWS/09 Rev. A, 3606/PWS/10.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - No staff car parking shall be available on site other than for disabled persons and operational parking. Prior to the installation of the new vehicle access gates for the development hereby approved the new 'Blue Badge' parking bay shall be clearly laid out on site and ready for usage.
 
Reason: To support the car-free nature of the development, other than for Blue Badge users, in accordance with Policy T2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - Within two weeks of the date of this permission an updated construction management plan shall be submitted to the Council's Transport Officer for their written approval and any reasonable requests for more information from that same officer shall be complied with.

Reason: To ensure the safe construction of the development in accordance with Policy T4 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - If during construction/demolition works, evidence of potential contamination is encountered, works shall cease and the site fully assessed to enable an appropriate remediation plan to be developed. Works shall not recommence until an appropriate remediation scheme has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority and the remediation has been completed. Upon completion of the building works, this condition shall not be discharged until a closure report has been submitted to, and improved in writing by, the local planning authority.

Reason: To protect workers and future occupiers of the development from the possible presence of ground contamination arising in connection with the previous industrial/storage use of the site in accordance with policies G1, D1, A1, and DM1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 6 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a pedestrian environment plan for the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval that shows how staff and visitors access the site safely and securely on foot, and makes appropriate safeguards to ensure there is not unnecessary or unsafe conflict between vehicle and pedestrian movements on site. Once agreed, the plan shall be complied with for as long as the development is in existence.

Reason: In accordance with Policy T1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017, which promotes walking and pedestrian environments in the borough.
Condition : 7 - Before first occupation of the development details of secure and covered cycle storage area for the offices and storage uses shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The approved facility shall thereafter be provided in its entirety prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, and permanently retained thereafter. 

Reason: To ensure the development provides adequate cycle parking facilities in accordance with the requirements of policy T1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 8 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a workplace travel plan (WTP) shall be submitted to the local planning authority for its written approval. Once approved the WTP shall be complied with as long as the development is in existence.

Reason: In order to ensure walking, cycling and public transport is prioritised over private vehicle usage in accordance with Policy T1 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 9 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a delivery and servicing plan (DSP) shall be submitted to the local planning authority for its written approval. Once approved the DSP shall be complied with as long as the development is in existence.

Reason: To promote the sustainable movement of goods and materials in accordance with Policy T4 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 10 - Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved a light spill plan showing expected light dispersal across and outside of the site as appropriate shall be submitted to the local planning authority for its written approval. Once approved the light levels shall not be exceeded as long as the development is in existence.

Reason: To ensure that light levels are not excessive and to protect biodiversity in the borough in accordance with Policy A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 11 - The air source heat pump systems which form part of the development hereby approved are required to utilise R32 refrigerant, or an alternative refrigerant with a lower global warming potential, unless otherwise agreed in writing in advance by the local planning authority.

Reason: To ensure development is resiliant to climate change and promotes sustainable design and construction methodologies in accordance with Policy CC2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 12 - Prior to the first occupation of development hereby approved a biodiverse planting scheme shall be submitted to the local planning authority for its written approval that provides planting within the site adjacent to the Site of Importance for Nature Conservation to improve the biodiversity of the site. Details shall include information on how the planting shall be installed and maintained. Once agreed the planting shall be retained and maintained as long as the development is in existence.

Reason: In order to adquately protect and enhance existing nature conservation areas in accordance with Policy A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 13 - All work shall be carried out in accordance with the details hereby approved in the Arboricultural Impact Statement and Method Statement dated March 2025.

Reason: To ensure the preservation of the amenity value and health of the tree(s) in accordance with the requirements of policy A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
